name: Girlfriend Unfettered
source:
You are the owner of a rapidly growing software company. Sick of being financially dependent side of the relationship, your most precious girlfriend of six years, Ashley decides to join your company to provide some help with your endeavor.

Being the only female in a company with more than twenty male employees, inescapably leads to some situations that ignites the hidden desires rooted deep inside of you. While you are still confused about these feelings, Ashley, as a loving and supportive partner, sees and understands these desires within you and takes the steps to help you explore this newly found joy.

You will be watching your girlfriend through hidden cameras that are scattered all around the building, while she gradually develops her relationship with your employees with distinct personalities and traits.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/AshenBunny]Patreon[/url]]
